title: Gray pilot explains implants as broken instrument tips for antibody harvesting

tellings.quote: "Because we take one or two cells of our diseased tissue, put it on that tip and implant it into you, and you will start making antibodies,

plain: In the mid-1960s, somewhere off Earth, a gray alien pilot told Lyn Buchanan that the so-called implants people find in their bodies are the broken-off tips of instruments, used to make humans produce antibodies. Buchanan, a former Army sergeant, says he heard it first-hand. He quotes the being as saying: "we take one or two cells of our diseased tissue, put it on that tip and implant it into you, and you will start making antibodies."
